summary: Cartesian Growth Corporation II, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting an October 12, 2026 unsecured promissory note of $150,000 issued to sponsor CGC II Sponsor LLC to fund working capital. The note bears no interest and matures upon either consummation of the initial business combination or effective winding up. At maturity the sponsor may convert principal into Working Capital Warrants at $1.00 per warrant, matching IPO private placement warrant terms and transfer restrictions. The note is a Section 4(a)(2) private placement. Watch for conversion overhang and any extension or liquidation timing risk.
